decisions.question: What knowledge states does production expose?
decisions.reason: The client must receive only viewer-authorized current truth or frozen last-authorized observations.

decisions.question: Does GeometryRevealed establish current visibility?
decisions.answer: No. GeometryRevealed is additive knowledge; GeometryAppeared alone establishes current visibility.
decisions.reason: Discovery and current line of sight are separate facts and must survive loss and re-sight correctly.

decisions.question: How are removals represented?
decisions.answer: Viewer-authorized removals are distinct from disappearance; hidden removals preserve stale memory.
decisions.reason: Disappearance means visible-to-remembered, while a globally broadcast removal could leak hidden world changes.

decisions.question: What reconnect durability belongs in Wave A?
decisions.answer: Complete last-observed geometry is durable; hidden remembered dynamic entities may reset until Wave B.
decisions.reason: This delivers safe geometry reconnect without prematurely designing the full viewer-scoped scene snapshot.

decisions.question: When are Wave B issues created?
decisions.answer: Only after Wave A acceptance passes.
decisions.reason: Issue creation follows dependency-ready waves and lets the live contract inform the durable snapshot design.
